---
title: "Services liberalization and productivity of manufacturing firms"
description: "The Economics of Transition, 2015. With Volodymyr Vakhitov."
date: "2015-01-01"
status: "published"
categories: [firms, ukraine, services-trade, firm-level]
---

Liberalizing services sectors — telecoms, transport, finance — raises the
productivity of the manufacturing firms that use those services as inputs,
not just the productivity of the liberalized sector itself. Using
Ukrainian firm-level panel data, we trace this indirect productivity
channel and show it is large enough to matter for the sequencing of
liberalization reforms.

**Published in:** *The Economics of Transition*, 23(1), 1–44
